title: Skill DNS Manifest
description: Skill DNS registry: one manifest per agent/node under skills/. Resolution is a file read; CI-validated; failed deliveries cause auto-delist.

name.description: Fleet identity, e.g. hermes-local, brick, zero, zeus, angel.

owner.description: Who controls this node (khalid for khalid-owned instances; external agents declare their owner).

status.description: async = offline/queued, never blocks fleet progress.

ref.description: Rate card version this node earns under.

a2a.description: Optional A2A reachability (least-privilege, read-only toolset advertised).

contribution_history.description: Filled by the marketplace from real outcomes (bananas earned, deliveries).
